title: [3.0-beta1] No BG delta on Beta1
body:
I'm having a persistent issue where BG changes (delta) at the top of the screen are reporting as "0" despite my BG obviously changing. This happens every time I bring up the app (app does run in the background, so I'm not talking about a fresh start). After a while, maybe 5 minutes (probably the next BG reading), the delta will show. 
Here's my info:
Samsung Galaxy Note 20 5g
AAPS 3.0-beta1
Omnipod Dash (communication and commands work great!)
![Screenshot_20211020-120624_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43968079/138345040-0baf1525-4b64-4270-a010-fc984e7484a2.jpg)


Logs: Ironically, just as I report this, it seems all is okay. So I don't have a log that shows the error at this moment. Will upload ASAP!
